thread:
erin: Scheduling v2 cutover tonight 23:00 PT. Plan: enable default-to-v2 + header shim. Ops-eyes assigned. Call out blockers now.

sam-sre: Quick question 8 what's the behavior when headers are missing? Some mobile clients strip custom headers.

erin: If no version header -> route to v2. If header explicitly says v1 -> route to v1. We flip `default_to_v2=true` in deploy.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy deploy-7155559999 at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. rollout=regional(10%,50%,100%), regions=[us-west1,us-east1,eu-west1]. Auto-pause thresholds attached.

josh-pm: Added a short note to release draft: "If you rely on v1, set X-API-Version: v1" and an FAQ entry. Erin, can we include a curl example?

erin: I'll paste an example in docs. Also adding `client_requested_version` metric for 72h to track explicit v1 requests.

sam-sre: Rollback triggers proposal: global 5xx > 0.8% for 5m OR p95 > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive minutes OR tenant spike > 0.6% traffic. Action: pin traffic to v1 for affected region and run rollback playbook.

gateway: Note: gateway lowercases headers in the proxy; routing expects `Accept-Version`. We've deployed a normalization patch to staging to map `accept-version` -> `Accept-Version` (PR #4581). Please monitor 400s.

deploy-bot: canary us-west1 10% pass at 23:02:10Z. Proceeding to 50% slice.

sam-sre: Observability ok so far. No tenant hotspots. Standing by for second region flip.

deploy-bot: rollout complete 23:38:20Z in all regions. No auto-pauses.

eric: Thanks team. Ops-eyes remains for 30m; if all green we'll promote release notes to stable and notify stakeholders.

josh-pm: I'll send the summary at +30m."
